7345.title: Scoped Git plugin checks use repository commits
7345.rootCauseOneLine: Branch update checks compare repository commits and materialize candidates without comparing the installed plugin subdirectory tree.
7345.proposedFix: Compare scoped Git trees before staging branch candidates; preserve normal validation on comparison failure.
7345.caveats: Staging is temporary cloning/validation, not a new persistent artifact. The complete reproduction is embedded in the HTML; raw artifacts remain local under reports repository policy.
